summary_markdown:
A user shared an analytics dashboard link showing a graph for Platform A, noting that the predicted product count appears significantly higher (almost double) than the previous day's prediction, and this pattern repeats daily. The user questioned if this was related to model calculation.
[me] confirmed that the prediction itself is fine. The issue stems from real-time data for the next UTC day entering the dashboard in the Brazilian timezone, causing abnormal traffic readings.
decisions: The high predicted product count fluctuation is due to time zone synchronization of real-time data.
action_items: [me] will investigate the issue further on Monday.
